def transform(grid):
    sep=next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0)
    a=grid[:sep]; b=grid[sep+1:]
    if len(a)!=len(b):
        return [[2 if x else 0 for x in row] for row in a]
    return [[2 if x!=0 and y!=0 else 0 for x,y in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(a,b)]

new='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if any(len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0 for row in grid):
        s = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
        a, b = grid[:s], grid[s+1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x,y in zip(ra,rb)] for ra,rb in zip(a,b)]
    s = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != 0)
    return [[2 if grid[i][j] != 0 and grid[i][j+s+1] != 0 else 0 for j in range(s)] for i in range(h)]
'''
